en: Better not touch this freezin' liquid.
ko: 이 얼어붙는 액체는 안 만지는 게 좋아.

en: This 'ere Voltspitter ain't workin'.
That's an odd-lookin' gun.
So this company's responsible for producin' weapons. Cool.
ko: 이 회사가 무기 생산을 담당하는구나. 멋져.

en: Big ol' stick o' iron brings lightnin' here.
ko: 커다란 철 막대가 여기로 번개를 끌어와.

en: Stuff on this table slips n' slides like it's nobody's business.
ko: 이 탁자 위 물건들이 아주 잘 미끄러져.

en: This 'ere trap drops Batterjaws! Perfectly devious.
ko: 이 함정은 배터조를 떨어뜨려! 완전히 교활해.

en: The floor's got a mind of its own.
This closet has a lil' snowflake at the top.
ko: 이 수납장 꼭대기엔 작은 눈송이가 있어.

en: Rifts ain't gonna go through 'ere.
The books seem a bit new.
An arrow but not for shootin'.
An ol' crystal that needs some replacin'.
Crystal replaced!
I better come back later if I wanna see what's behind this sign.
ko: 이 표지판 뒤에 뭐가 있는지 보려면 나중에 돌아오는 게 좋겠어.

en: It's a blue barrel for storin' a lotta things.
This pedestal looks awfully like a booby trap.
An ol' lock on an ol' door.
This 'ere hatch is rusty but sturdy.
I'll need to look for a keycard.
How on earth does a mushroom make a door?
Seems t'me like this is where the arrows're pointin'.
It's a blue barrel for storin' things.
How on earth does a mushroom make a hatch?
What's a giant coil of copper around some iron doin' down 'ere?
ko: 철 주위에 감긴 거대한 구리 코일이 여기서 뭐 하는 거지?

en: Warnin' sign for fallin' crates. I'd best watch myself.
Better get outta here before I get zapped by one of these things.
ko: 이 중 하나에 감전되기 전에 나가는 게 좋겠어.

en: Best not to get caught near this thing when it activates.
ko: 이게 활성화될 때 근처에 있으면 안 돼.

en: This thing's broken, but I might be able to do somethin' with that lil' orb floatin' inside it.
ko: 이건 고장 났지만 안에 떠 있는 작은 구슬로 뭔가 할 수 있을지도.

en: This 'ere gate console's frickin' hot!
That's one big furnace.
This skull's stealin' items offa dead people.
ko: 이 해골은 죽은 사람한테서 물건을 훔쳐.

en: The guns outta this old machine will be pretty powerful.
ko: 이 오래된 기계에서 나오는 총은 꽤 강력할 거야.

en: What a crazy trap. Shootin' grenades everywhere.
This 'ere pedestal holds a tech chip.
This teleporter's good for movin' big cargo.
ko: 이 텔레포터는 큰 화물을 옮기기에 좋아.

en: Gotta be quick to open the door ahead.
I'm not likin' this painting.
It drips out boilin' hot lava.
An "open" sign. It ain't workin' anymore.
ko: '영업 중' 표지판. 더는 작동 안 해.

en: I'll need to activate somethin' to make this glow orange.
ko: 이걸 주황으로 빛나게 하려면 뭔가를 활성화해야겠어.
